walletChangedTransaction: Your wallet changed the transaction, so Buckspay couldn't cover its network cost. Nothing was sent and nothing was charged. Open Buckspay in Phantom or Solflare, or add about 0.005 SOL to activate with your own wallet.

fee.charged: Buckspay charges a fee of {{amount}}, on top of your funds.

networkCost.sponsored: Buckspay pays the network costs. Your wallet pays nothing else.
networkCost.wallet: Your wallet pays the network costs, about {{sol}} SOL. Not refundable.

withdrawalDate: You can take your funds back from {{date}} (UTC).

summary.withSlashed: {{backing}} available offline, {{bond}} security deposit free, {{slashed}} destroyed

withdrawal.now: You can take your funds back now.
withdrawal.from: You can take your funds back from {{date}} (UTC).

rotation: Someone asked to move this phone to wallet {{wallet}}. It takes effect on {{date}} (UTC). If this wasn't you, cancel it now.
addFundsBody: New funds go into another reserve that backs what you pay. You can take them back after the reserve ends and its withdrawal window opens.
cancelAndPay: Cancel and pay from my wallet
withdrawAndPay: Withdraw and pay from my wallet

problem.nothingSent: Nothing was sent and nothing was charged.

sponsor.mismatch: Buckspay’s server offered a transaction this app didn’t ask for, so your wallet never saw it.
sponsor.unsupported: Your wallet can’t sign a transaction that Buckspay pays for.
sponsor.altered: Your wallet changed the transaction before signing it, so it wasn’t sent.
sponsor.unsigned: Your wallet couldn’t sign the transaction.

problem.reconnect: Your wallet no longer recognizes Buckspay. Connect it again.
problem.checkConnection: Check your connection and try again.
problem.cantReachBoth: Can’t reach Solana or Buckspay. Check your connection. The transaction may not have been sent; check before trying again.
problem.incomplete: The transaction didn’t complete. It may or may not have been sent; check before trying again.
problem.slow: Solana was slow to see the transaction.
problem.rejected: Solana rejected the transaction. No funds moved.
problem.unconfirmed: Solana hasn’t confirmed the transaction yet. It may still go through; check your reserves in a minute.
problem.lowSol: Your wallet has {{balance}} SOL and this costs about {{cost}} SOL in network costs. Add SOL to your wallet, then try again. Nothing was sent.

rotationAsk: Was this you? If not, cancel it now.
